svg.title: Which copy leaked
svg.desc: Left: an excerpt of a leaked note with five swapped words marked: do not, it is, 10, please, till, which are slots 2 to 6 of 15 in the demo note. Right: ten copies, each a row of 15 bits. The leak is read slot by slot, every copy that disagrees is struck out, and only copy 1 remains. Result, as the app shows it: the canary sang, copy 1 of 10, made for Priya, 5 of 5 fingerprints match, with her open receipt 5TXF…Asy2 on Solana.
